title: They laughed it off.
paragraphs:
They laughed it off.
Changed the topic.
Said, “I’m good.”
And you felt it.

That quiet ache in your chest…
Because deep down, you know eternity is not a joke.

Evangelism is not easy.
It feels awkward.
It risks relationships.
It exposes your own fears.
But here’s the truth we don’t say out loud—

Watching someone you love drift toward eternity without Christ…
is a different kind of pain.
A heavier one.

Because Jesus didn’t whisper about hell.
He spoke of it with tears behind His words (see Matthew 10, Matthew 25).
Not to scare—but to save.
And we stay silent?

We protect comfort over calling.
We choose peace over truth.
We say “later”… while time is slipping.
But here’s what we miss—

You are not called to convert.
You are called to witness.

Only Jesus saves.
Only the cross redeems.
Only His blood rewrites a sinner’s ending.
Your job?

Love them enough to speak.
Pray like heaven is listening.
Share like eternity is real.
Because it is.
And that friend… that sibling… that person you keep thinking about right now—
They matter.

Not just for today.
For forever.

So don’t carry silent love.
Carry bold grace.

Speak Jesus.
Even if your voice shakes.

Because one day, we won’t regret being rejected…
We’ll regret staying quiet.
And here’s the hope—

No one is too far.
No heart too hard.
No story too broken.
Christ still saves.
Right now.
Pray for that person. Then reach out.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
